current_qrom_reader.fri_schedule_scope: Public parser arithmetic; reachable seals and full IOR rounds are unproved.

complete_computation_relation.protected_claim: The exact allowed computation relation, images, public values and recursion family are satisfied.
unclosed: Separate native full replay from the isolated succinct-proof candidate.
Whole implemented relation, RBR/state-restoration and vector-commitment extraction assumptions.
Concrete shared hash/sponge/transcript model, recursive composition and all permitted control programs.
A complete theorem-derived lifetime bound; current record is not fresh receipt verification.

pq_authorization.protected_claim: The currently authorized owner approved these exact domain-bound bytes.
unclosed: Independent implementation/side-channel assessment and algorithm security assumptions.
Complete authority-producing entry-point coverage and current external trust-root/custody evidence.
Migration, revocation, replay, rollback and deployment composition across actual effect paths.
Lifetime multi-user authorization failure bound; local signature meters are not adversary query limits.

quantum_work_and_chain_weight.protected_claim: Adversarial resource expenditure corresponds to lottery wins and credited branch weight under the actual fork rule.
unclosed: Cheapest legal attacker strategy, preprocessing/task reuse, subset marked counts and all query costs.
Physical clock/error correction/data-access assumptions and hardware calibration.
Adaptive target/timestamp/withholding/restart/propagation behavior under actual branch reachability.
Common-prefix/confirmation or other named security definition at equal additive resource budgets.

independent_acceptance.rule: Each claim requires its own evidence; signature validity, relation correctness and resource security do not imply one another.

pq128_reader.note: Exact arithmetic over declared inputs only. References, source hashes and node logs do not prove a PQ128 security claim; no unconditional bound or activation is produced.

proof_profile_reader.note: A source/profile binding is not a security theorem. The native-PNW1 register and both P3 candidates supply no selected-profile failure bound; byte pins and endpoint equality do not authenticate a deployed implementation.

setup_recovery_scope: Reserved the output directory as required by the existing workflow; no source, test roster, test case, input, parameter, or acceptance rule changed.
